name: Stepper
description: A horizontal or vertical multi-step progress indicator whose connectors fill with the accent color and whose step numbers morph into drawn check marks as you advance. Includes Back/Next demo controls and optional click-to-revisit for completed steps.
a11yNotes: Steps are an ordered list labelled 'Progress'; the current step has aria-current="step" and each title carries visually hidden '(completed)' or '(current step)' text. Completed steps become native buttons ('Go back to step N: Title') when clickable. Back/Next are native buttons (Back is disabled on the first step) and a polite live region announces 'Step X of Y: Title'. Connector lines and icons are aria-hidden. Reduced motion removes the fill, scale and path-draw animations.

propsApi.name: activeStep
propsApi.description: Controlled active step index (0-based); steps.length means every step is complete.

propsApi.name: onStepChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next active step index.

propsApi.name: size
propsApi.description: Step circle and text size preset.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of completed steps, the current ring and connector fill.

propsApi.name: clickable
propsApi.description: Completed steps become buttons that jump back to them.

propsApi.name: showControls
propsApi.description: Show the status line and Back / Next buttons.

propsApi.name: nextLabel
propsApi.description: Label of the Next button (the last step shows 'Finish').

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
